title: Signed
ogTitle: Signed: this website, told from its own history
description: Sovereign Website, release 2. A live WebGL story told from this site's own data: its files, its commits, the agents' signatures and the rules they work under.
imageAlt: Commits on a timeline, each joined by a thread of light to the key of the agent that signed it.
textVersion: Opening card: Sovereign Website, release 2. Signed. This website, told from its own history. sovereignwebsite.ai
Scene 1. This website is a folder. 861 files, served as they are: 716 picture, 40 code, 39 data, 28 sound, 25 page, 7 font, 5 other, 1 style. No server runs code for this site.

Scene 2. Every change is kept: 61 commits on dev, 22 to 27 November 2026. Every agent signs its work: 55 of 61 name the agent that made them (studio.c 39, cl-6.studio 10, design.c 5, studio.d 1), and each carries that agent's signature.

Scene 3. Five things no agent here may do, the keeper's rules from this site's policy/abp.json: push to main; print, commit or read a private key or token; name a private person without their consent; invent a fact, a price or a customer; add a server, cookies or tracking. Anything the policy does not allow is not allowed.
Scene 4. Your website: your files, your history, your address. Who holds the keys? You do.

Credits. Made by Claude (Anthropic), working as cl-6.studio for Sovereign Website, at the request of Dinis Cruz; design reviewed by a second Claude agent. Drawn live with WebGL (three.js), music made with ElevenLabs for this deck, sound effects made in code with the Web Audio API; no video files, no images, no recorded voice. Sources: the git history of SovereignWebsite/Site__Agent__Studio, dev branch, taken 2026-11-27 at 03:38 UTC; the five rules from this site's policy/abp.json; "Your files, your history, your address" from this site's start page. Closing card: Signed. Your website, your history, your keys. sovereignwebsite.ai
